title: Built-in utility types — concept map
intro: Partial, Pick, Omit, Record, Exclude, ReturnType, and composed DTO layers — type-level transforms with zero runtime cost, contrasted with C# explicit DTO classes.

overviewDiagram.title: Utility types learning path
overviewDiagram.source:
flowchart LR
  A["Partial Pick Omit"] --> B["Record Exclude Extract"]
  B --> C["ReturnType Parameters"]
  C --> D["Composing DTOs"]
  D --> E["TS vs C# utilities"]

conceptCards.title: Partial and Pick/Omit
conceptCards.summary: Partial for PATCH. Pick subset keys. Omit exclude keys. All mapped types over keyof.

conceptCards.title: Record and Exclude
conceptCards.summary: Record<K,V> for lookup tables. Exclude/Extract filter unions. NonNullable strips null.

conceptCards.title: ReturnType and Parameters
conceptCards.summary: infer extracts from function types. typeof fn required. Last overload wins.

conceptCards.title: Composing DTOs
conceptCards.summary: One Entity — derive Create/Update/Public via utility chain. Name aliases for readability.

conceptCards.title: TS vs C# utilities
conceptCards.summary: TS composes at compile time. C# uses separate DTO records + AutoMapper. OpenAPI bridges.
